# Supine Human Model

Downloaded from [UMRAM-Bilkent/supine-human-model](https://github.com/UMRAM-Bilkent/supine-human-model).

- `human_posed.glb` is used for the seven patients lying in ward beds.
- `human_rigged.glb` is used for the running/violent patient.
- Original character: Quaternius.
